name: Partner Ecosystem Essentials
description: A baseline practice framework for engaging with partner ecosystems in open hybrid cloud and enterprise platform business models, covering partner lifecycle management, technical enablement, co-sell orchestration, and value realization.

focuses.name: Value
focuses.description: Focuses on partner-driven business value, revenue models, and ecosystem ROI.

focuses.name: Solution
focuses.description: Encapsulates partner technical integration, certification, and co-created offerings.

focuses.name: Endeavor
focuses.description: Governs partner relationship execution, enablement programs, and operational workflows.

alphas.name: Partner Opportunity
alphas.description: The business drivers and market opportunities that motivate partner ecosystem engagement and expansion.

states.name: Identified
states.description: A potential partner ecosystem opportunity is recognized in a market segment or technology domain.

states.name: Qualified
states.description: The partner opportunity is assessed against Ideal Partner Profile (IPP) criteria and strategic fit.

states.name: Valued
states.description: The potential partner-driven ARR, market reach, and technical capabilities are quantified.

states.name: Prioritized
states.description: The opportunity is prioritized within the ecosystem portfolio and resourced appropriately.

states.name: Engaged
states.description: Active partnership activities are underway to address the opportunity.

states.name: Realized
states.description: The partnership is delivering measurable business outcomes and ecosystem value.

alphas.name: Partner Revenue Model
alphas.description: The financial and incentive structures that govern how partners generate and share revenue within the ecosystem.

states.name: Defined
states.description: The revenue-sharing, rebate, or incentive model is established for the partner type (Resell, CCSP, ISV).

states.name: Aligned
states.description: Partner incentives are aligned with consumption-based, recurring revenue models rather than transactional bookings.

states.name: Automated
states.description: Revenue attribution, deal registration, and incentive crediting are automated through integrated systems.

states.name: Optimized
states.description: The revenue model drives predictable partner behavior and maximizes ecosystem ROI.

alphas.name: Partner Performance
alphas.description: The measurable outcomes and KPIs tracking partner contribution to ecosystem goals.

states.name: Baselined
states.description: Initial partner performance metrics and targets are established.

states.name: Tracked
states.description: Partner-sourced ARR, influenced pipeline, and technical milestones are actively monitored.

states.name: Reviewed
states.description: Regular Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) assess performance against Partner Success Plans.

states.name: Optimized
states.description: Performance data drives continuous improvement in partner engagement strategies.

alphas.name: Partner Relationship
alphas.description: The structured engagement between the organization and its partner organizations, from registration through strategic alliance.

states.name: Registered
states.description: Partner has enrolled in the ecosystem program and gained portal access.

states.name: Onboarded
states.description: Partner has completed initial enablement and understands program structure.

states.name: Activated
states.description: Partner has logged first deal, completed first certification, or launched first co-marketing activity.

states.name: Engaged
states.description: Partner is actively selling, building, or delivering with regular cadence of activities.

states.name: Strategic
states.description: Partner has achieved Premier/Advanced tier with dedicated PAM and joint business planning.

states.name: Renewing
states.description: Partnership value is being sustained through ongoing investment and mutual commitment.

alphas.name: Partner Program
alphas.description: The structured framework of tiers, tracks, incentives, and enablement that governs partner ecosystem participation.

states.name: Designed
states.description: Program tiers, modules (Build, Resell, Sell With, CCSP), and progression criteria are defined.

states.name: Launched
states.description: Partner portal, program documentation, and enrollment workflows are operational.

states.name: Governed
states.description: Points-based meritocracy, tier progression, and automated crediting systems are enforced.

states.name: Evolving
states.description: Program rules, incentives, and benefits adapt based on partner feedback and market dynamics.

alphas.name: Partner Capability
alphas.description: The technical skills, certifications, specializations, and delivery competencies that partners develop to serve the ecosystem.

states.name: Assessed
states.description: Partner's current technical capabilities and skill gaps are identified.

states.name: Developing
states.description: Partner team members are actively pursuing training and certifications.

states.name: Certified
states.description: Partner has achieved required technical certifications and validated competencies.

states.name: Specialized
states.description: Partner has developed deep expertise in specific technology areas or use cases.

states.name: Scaling
states.description: Partner is independently delivering solutions and training new team members.

alphas.name: Partner Solution
alphas.description: The co-created technical offerings, integrations, and services that partners develop and deliver to joint customers.

states.name: Identified
states.description: A potential solution or integration opportunity is recognized.

states.name: Designed
states.description: Solution architecture is defined with clear integration points to platform offerings.

states.name: Validated
states.description: Partner has self-validated compatibility and basic functionality.

states.name: Certified
states.description: Solution has achieved formal certification and ecosystem catalog placement.

states.name: In Market
states.description: Solution is actively sold, supported, and deployed with joint customers.

states.name: Evolving
states.description: Solution roadmap is aligned with platform evolution and customer feedback.

alphas.name: Partner Certification
alphas.description: The formal validation and certification processes that verify partner solutions meet technical, security, and lifecycle standards.

states.name: Initiated
states.description: Partner has begun the certification process and understands requirements.

states.name: Testing
states.description: Solution is undergoing validation testing for compatibility, security, and performance.

states.name: Certified
states.description: Solution has passed all certification requirements and earned ecosystem badge.

states.name: Published
states.description: Certified solution is published in ecosystem catalog with support commitments.

states.name: Maintained
states.description: Certification is kept current through regular recertification and lifecycle management.

alphas.name: Partner Enablement
alphas.description: The training, technical resources, documentation, and support provided to build partner capabilities.

states.name: Scoped
states.description: Enablement needs are assessed and training curriculum is defined.

states.name: Available
states.description: Training portal, courses, labs, and technical documentation are accessible.

states.name: Delivered
states.description: Partners are actively consuming enablement resources and completing certifications.

states.name: Self-Service
states.description: Enablement is automated with on-demand access and automated crediting for completions.

alphas.name: Partner Governance
alphas.description: The policies, compliance requirements, and operational controls that govern partner ecosystem operations.

states.name: Defined
states.description: Partner program rules, deal registration policies, and conflict resolution processes are documented.

states.name: Enforced
states.description: Governance policies are actively monitored and violations are addressed.

states.name: Automated
states.description: Deal protection, territory rules, and incentive eligibility are enforced through automated systems.

activitySpaces.name: Identify Partner Opportunities
activitySpaces.description: Scan the market for potential partner relationships that align with strategic technology areas and customer needs.

activitySpaces.name: Assess Partner Value
activitySpaces.description: Evaluate potential partner contributions including technical capabilities, market reach, customer relationships, and ARR potential against Ideal Partner Profile.

activitySpaces.name: Track Partner Performance
activitySpaces.description: Monitor partner-sourced ARR, influenced pipeline, certification progress, and program engagement through automated dashboards and QBR scorecards.

activitySpaces.name: Design Revenue Models
activitySpaces.description: Define partner-specific incentive structures, rebate programs, and consumption-based compensation aligned with recurring revenue objectives.

activitySpaces.name: Onboard Partners
activitySpaces.description: Execute event-driven onboarding workflows with tailored activation tracks for ISVs, resellers, and service providers.

activitySpaces.name: Manage Partner Relationships
activitySpaces.description: Orchestrate ongoing partner engagement through Partner Success Plans, QBRs, executive alignment, and cross-functional coordination.

activitySpaces.name: Orchestrate Co-Sell Activities
activitySpaces.description: Coordinate matrixed co-selling efforts including account mapping, deal registration, joint pipeline management, and territory alignment.

activitySpaces.name: Develop Partner Programs
activitySpaces.description: Design and evolve partner program structure including tiers, modules, progression criteria, and points-based meritocracy systems.

activitySpaces.name: Enable Partner Capabilities
activitySpaces.description: Deliver technical training, certification programs, workshops, and hands-on enablement to build partner skills and specializations.

activitySpaces.name: Guide Solution Development
activitySpaces.description: Support partners in building and validating co-created solutions, integrations, and service offerings aligned with platform roadmap.

activitySpaces.name: Manage Certification Processes
activitySpaces.description: Execute partner solution certification workflows including testing, validation, security review, and ecosystem catalog publication.

activitySpaces.name: Execute Joint Go-To-Market
activitySpaces.description: Plan and deliver co-marketing campaigns, events, demand generation, and customer-facing activities leveraging Market Development Funds.

activitySpaces.name: Govern Partner Ecosystem
activitySpaces.description: Enforce program rules, resolve channel conflicts, manage deal registration, and maintain governance policies.

competencies.name: Partner Strategic Alignment
competencies.description: The ability to align partner ecosystem strategy with business objectives, market opportunities, and technology roadmaps.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Understands the purpose of partner ecosystems and basic program structures.

levels.name: Applies
levels.description: Can articulate how specific partner types contribute to go-to-market strategy.

levels.name: Masters
levels.description: Can independently develop partner strategies and Ideal Partner Profiles aligned with business goals.

levels.name: Adapts
levels.description: Can pivot ecosystem strategy in response to market dynamics and competitive pressures.

levels.name: Innovating
levels.description: Pioneers new partner business models and ecosystem strategies that redefine industry norms.

competencies.name: Ecosystem Analysis
competencies.description: The ability to assess partner capabilities, market potential, and ecosystem performance using data-driven methods.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Can read basic partner performance reports and understand key metrics.

levels.name: Applies
levels.description: Can analyze partner performance against targets and identify trends.

levels.name: Masters
levels.description: Can independently design QBR scorecards and translate data into actionable partner strategies.

levels.name: Adapts
levels.description: Can build predictive models for partner success and ecosystem ROI optimization.

levels.name: Innovating
levels.description: Develops novel analytical frameworks for ecosystem intelligence and partner valuation.

competencies.name: Partner Relationship Management
competencies.description: The ability to build, nurture, and manage strategic relationships with partner organizations.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Understands partner communication channels and basic engagement protocols.

levels.name: Applies
levels.description: Can execute Partner Success Plans and conduct routine partner touchpoints.

levels.name: Masters
levels.description: Can independently manage strategic partner portfolios and navigate complex organizational dynamics.

levels.name: Adapts
levels.description: Can build executive-level relationships and orchestrate multi-partner alliances.

levels.name: Innovating
levels.description: Creates transformative partnership models that become industry benchmarks.

competencies.name: Partner Co-Sell Orchestration
competencies.description: The ability to coordinate co-selling activities across matrixed partner and direct sales teams.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Understands deal registration and basic co-sell processes.

levels.name: Applies
levels.description: Can facilitate account mapping and coordinate simple joint sales motions.

levels.name: Masters
levels.description: Can independently orchestrate complex multi-threaded co-sell campaigns and manage pipeline commitments.

levels.name: Adapts
levels.description: Can architect co-sell frameworks across multiple partner types and geographies.

levels.name: Innovating
levels.description: Develops novel co-sell methodologies that maximize ecosystem leverage.

competencies.name: Partner Technical Enablement
competencies.description: The ability to design and deliver technical training and enablement programs for partner audiences.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Can deliver basic product training using existing materials.

levels.name: Applies
levels.description: Can customize enablement content for different partner technical roles.

levels.name: Masters
levels.description: Can design comprehensive certification programs and hands-on technical workshops.

levels.name: Adapts
levels.description: Can build self-service enablement platforms and adaptive learning pathways.

levels.name: Innovating
levels.description: Pioneers new partner enablement methodologies and learning technologies.

competencies.name: Partner Solutions Architecture
competencies.description: The ability to guide partners in designing, validating, and certifying technical integrations and solutions.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Understands basic integration patterns and partner solution requirements.

levels.name: Applies
levels.description: Can assist partners with solution design and technical troubleshooting.

levels.name: Masters
levels.description: Can independently guide partners through complex integrations and certification processes.

levels.name: Adapts
levels.description: Can architect multi-vendor solutions and resolve systemic integration challenges.

levels.name: Innovating
levels.description: Develops breakthrough integration patterns and ecosystem reference architectures.

competencies.name: Partner Operations Management
competencies.description: The ability to manage partner program operations, systems, and automated workflows.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Can navigate partner portals and execute basic operational tasks.

levels.name: Applies
levels.description: Can manage deal registration, MDF allocation, and program compliance.

levels.name: Masters
levels.description: Can design and optimize partner operational workflows and automation.

levels.name: Adapts
levels.description: Can architect integrated partner ecosystems and PRM platforms.

levels.name: Innovating
levels.description: Creates novel ecosystem operations paradigms and automation frameworks.

competencies.name: Partner Conflict Resolution
competencies.description: The ability to identify, mediate, and resolve channel conflicts and multi-partner disputes.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Understands common sources of channel conflict and escalation paths.

levels.name: Applies
levels.description: Can mediate simple territory or deal registration conflicts.

levels.name: Masters
levels.description: Can independently resolve complex multi-partner conflicts while preserving relationships.

levels.name: Adapts
levels.description: Can design conflict prevention frameworks and scalable resolution processes.

levels.name: Innovating
levels.description: Develops transformative approaches to ecosystem governance and conflict prevention.
